_comment: LEVEL 3 (feature): search infra — Meilisearch/Typesense client + indexing + query. Composes with feature-crud/comp-search-filter for full-stack search. Stack-saas future: feature-search-infra will be in stack-saas uses[].
name: feature-search-infra
description: Full-text search infra: Meilisearch/Typesense HTTP client, index + search with ranking, health endpoint. Pairs with comp-search-filter for SQL fallback.
notes: After applying: 1) set SEARCH_URL + SEARCH_API_KEY in .env, 2) app.include_router(router) in main.py, 3) create index on first index_document call. For stack-saas: this will be composed via uses[] in stack-saas. Requires httpx. Composes with comp-search-filter for list filtering fallback.
